<h1>About the Repository</h1>
<p>This repository documents MS Emon's research direction across systems thinking, neuroscience, e-commerce, and customer-centric decision frameworks.</p>
<p>It is designed as a focused public research space: concise working notes, structured synthesis, and future analytical studies will be published here as the collection develops.</p>
<p>For formal publications and author information, visit <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Md-Salauddin-Emon" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">ResearchGate</a>.</p>
